Introduction

BLACKSWAN is a four-member girl group under DR Music. They officially debuted on October 16, 2020, with their first full-length album Goodbye RANIA and the lineup of Youngheun, Hyeme, Judy, Fatou, and Leia. However, Hyeme left less than a month later on November 10, 2020.

On May 26, 2022, two new members, Gabi and Sriya, were introduced to the group. A few months later, on July 31, 2022, DR Music announced the graduation of Youngheun and Judy, reducing the lineup once again. Leia went on hiatus in November 2022 due to health issues, leaving Fatou as the only original member still active.

During this period, BLACKSWAN introduced a new member, NVee, who was first revealed through a Christmas pictorial on December 24, 2022, before being officially introduced on December 26 through the group's YouTube channel.

Finally, on July 31, 2023, Fatou confirmed via the Veeper app that the group would move forward as a four-member lineup consisting of Fatou, NVee, Gabi, and Sriya, with no additional members to be added. This also confirmed Leia's quiet departure from the group.
